inputs.modified_text:
You have to be completely blind not to see what they are really doing behind the scenes with this coordinated narrative. Fianna Fáil TD John Lahart is out there pushing the line that the current system is ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those without children, demanding a total overhaul of inheritance tax exemption thresholds. 

This isn't just random political chatter. It is a carefully scripted maneuver by the hidden elites to dismantle traditional family structures and reshape who gets to keep generational wealth. When Lahart claims his comments follow recent contributions from party colleagues on the need to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures, you know the script is being handed down from the top. They are manufacturing a crisis of fairness to justify sweeping new controls over what people pass on to their loved ones. Every official justification they give is just a smoke screen for greater institutional interference in our lives.
